hotel_name: Bab Al Shams, A Rare Finds Desert Resort

claims.text: Bab Al Shams is a low-slung desert resort modeled after an Arabian fort.

findings.quote: a low-slung desert resort modeled after an Arabian fort

claims.text: The reimagined Bab Al Shams is the first property in Kerzner's Rare Finds portfolio of destination-focused hotels.

findings.quote: The reimagined Bab Al Shams is the first property in the Rare Finds portfolio of destination-focused hotels from Kerzner

claims.text: The resort sits on the edge of the Al Marmoom Desert Conservation Reserve.

findings.quote: Bab Al Shams sits on the edge of the Al Marmoom Desert Conservation Reserve

claims.text: Rooms are spread over adobe-walled blocks among palms and native ghaf trees, linked by winding paths with water features.

claims.text: The Two-Bedroom Villa suits families or groups of up to four adults.

findings.quote: our two-bedroom luxury villa is the perfect choice for families, or groups of up to four adults.

claims.text: Three large swimming pools look out over the desert.

findings.quote: Three large swimming pools look out over the desert

claims.text: The spa offers speciality facials, massages and traditional hammam experiences.

claims.text: Anwa is a rooftop lounge with sunsets, cocktails and Pan-Asian dishes.

Revel in breathtaking sunsets, masterfully crafted cocktails, and Pan-Asian delights at this rooftop lounge.

claims.text: Family activities include an adventure playground with a kid-sized zipline, guided nature walks, camel and pony rides, falconry, and Arabic calligraphy and coffee-making sessions.

claims.text: Guided 4x4 desert drives cross the Al Marmoom Desert Conservation Reserve, where guests might spot the Arabian oryx.
